import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.feature_selection import mutual_info_classif
from collections import defaultdict

MAX_DRIVERS = 2

def design(feats):
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    corr_pairs = [(a, b) for a, b in [
        ('GGD5B', 'JKA3'), ('UHNI16', 'JKA3'), ('GGD5B', 'UHNI16'),
        ('GRSZ12', 'ASW15'), ('PRXX11', 'BIG19'), ('FVGK3', 'YZFD16B'),
        ('HRSL9P', 'YZFD16B'), ('TZKT17', 'ASW15'), ('LWL13', 'SGX17'),
        ('IPGJ17', 'YZFD16B'), ('GGD5B', 'YZFD16B'), ('JCJ19P', 'BIG19'),
        ('HGE5', 'HRSL9P'), ('HGE5', 'YZFD16B'), ('FVGK3', 'HRSL9P'),
        ('TZKT17', 'GRSZ12'), ('JCJ19P', 'PRXX11'), ('JCJ19P', 'ERG13P'),
        ('GGD5B', 'FVGK3'), ('JKA3', 'YZFD16B')
    ] if a in feats.ids and b in feats.ids]
    
    dup_features = set()
    for a, b in corr_pairs:
        if a not in dup_features and b not in dup_features:
            # Keep the one with higher effect size
            idx_a = feats.column(a)
            idx_b = feats.column(b)
            effect_a = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, idx_a]) - np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, idx_a])
            effect_b = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, idx_b]) - np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, idx_b])
            dup_features.add(a if abs(effect_a) > abs(effect_b) else b)
    
    # Select top features by effect size
    effects = []
    for fid in feats.ids:
        if fid in dup_features:
            continue
        idx = feats.column(fid)
        effect = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, idx]) - np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, idx])
        effects.append((abs(effect), fid))
    
    effects.sort(reverse=True)
    selected_features = [fid for _, fid in effects[:10]]
    
    # Check if any mechanism exists using logistic regression
    X = feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in selected_features]]
    model = LogisticRegression(penalty='l1', solver='liblinear', C=0.1)
    try:
        model.fit(X, feats.y)
        coefs = np.abs(model.coef_[0])
        if max(coefs) > 0.1:  # Significant coefficients
            # Select top drivers
            top_indices = np.argsort(coefs)[-MAX_DRIVERS:][::-1]
            drivers = tuple(selected_features[i] for i in top_indices)
            
            # Build full model features
            columns = tuple(selected_features)
            products = ()
            loadings = {}
            
            # Add top features to loadings
            for i, fid in enumerate(selected_features):
                loadings[fid] = coefs[i]
                
            return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=products, loadings=loadings)
    except:
        pass
    
    # No mechanism found
    return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
